properties.legend_description: Alluvial sands, gravels, clays, mangrove swamps, pebbles (Quaternary); sands, clays, coals, shales, sandstones, mudstones, limestones, siltstones, ironstones, grits (mostly Cretaceous)
Sands, clays, shales, sandstones, lignites, grits
Younger granites: granites, syenites, gabbros, rhyolites (Jurassic)
